In migrated git history, commit 81d1bff591ce339694764d726741b17b6770fe00 carries the #5938 application message for extension type profile parsing, and nearby commit db55db7414cc49a9bd93c668c9fd19c3de26fccf changes SpreadsheetParser.parseExtensionElement so Extension.value[x] Type values are parsed with inProfile=true instead of false.
additional_context: The affected QICore AdverseEvent profile was historical content. source/other/adverseevent-qicore-profile-spreadsheet.xml was later renamed when Other became Basic and then moved out of core source under CQF/QICore work. Current source/fhir.ini keeps Basic and AdverseEvent as active resources but its active [profiles] list contains current core profile/extension spreadsheets and no QICore AdverseEvent profile package. The old Java TypeParser/SpreadsheetParser publisher code is absent from the current checkout. Related FHIR-5955 is already represented on the combined branch and was not duplicated.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The requested tooling behavior was applied historically, and neither the failing old parser code nor the specific QICore AdverseEvent profile/extension source remains in the current FHIR core build.
